objective: Measure consumer intent, merchant-attributable outcomes, repeat use and data freshness in a way that can support buyer-specific synergy analysis without overstating clicks as bookings or revenue.

existingRuntimeAlignment.productionRule: No Production analytics payload or identifier before RT-008 privacy release-ready AND explicit analytics consent.

eventSemantics.meaning: Restaurant profile opened. Not a lead, booking or sale.
Menu/content opened. Stronger consideration, not a commercial outcome.
A service/contact-related surface was opened; not proof the service was consumed.
User initiated route/directions. High-intent action, not proof of visit.
User opened merchant website. Handoff only.
Call action initiated. Not proof a call connected or converted.
Reservation flow/handoff started. Not a confirmed reservation.
Reservation submission/handoff event. Not a confirmed reservation. It must never be reported as a confirmed booking without independent confirmation.

merchantOutcomeLadder.meaning: HOY observed a consented high-intent action such as route, call, website or reservation handoff.
Verified operator confirms an attributable inquiry/lead under a documented matching rule.
Verified operator confirms an attributable reservation/order/visit or other agreed transaction.
Verified operator provides an attributable transaction value or bounded value range under an explicit evidence method.

sponsored.claim: Attributed HOY action, not incremental causality.

organic.claim: HOY-originated action signal, not proof of transaction.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: paid_businesses
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: Distinct external businesses with at least one settled payment under ACQ-03.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: recurring_mrr_eur
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: Active recurring monthly contracted value backed by settled external business payments; one-off Highlight spend excluded.
coreBuyerValueMetrics.buyerValue: Supports recurring economics and financial-buyer relevance.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: paid_business_retention_90d
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: Share of eligible paying businesses still in a paid relationship at >=90 days under a frozen cohort rule.
coreBuyerValueMetrics.buyerValue: Tests durable merchant value rather than first-payment curiosity.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: qualified_high_intent_action_sessions
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: Consented production sessions containing >=1 high-intent action; deduplicated by session and restaurant.
coreBuyerValueMetrics.buyerValue: Measures consumer commercial intent without pretending it is revenue.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: merchant_confirmed_outcomes
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: Count of M2+ outcomes confirmed by verified operators, separately reported by M2/M3/M4 level.
coreBuyerValueMetrics.buyerValue: Bridges product usage to merchant value.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: merchant_outcome_rate
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: M2+ confirmed outcomes divided by eligible attributable high-intent action groups under the same frozen attribution protocol.
coreBuyerValueMetrics.buyerValue: Tests whether HOY intent produces acknowledged merchant outcomes.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: activated_consumer_repeat_30d
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: Among consented users whose activation session contains >=1 high-intent action, share with another qualifying session on a different calendar day within 30 days. Report denominator and consent coverage; never extrapolate to all visitors.
coreBuyerValueMetrics.buyerValue: Tests repeat utility rather than vanity reach.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: merchant_first_party_confirmation_coverage
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: Share of launch-critical published merchant records whose defined critical fields have current business-confirmed or HOY-verified evidence under the relevant trust model.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: critical_data_freshness_sla
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: Share of launch-critical fields inside their field-specific freshness window, reported by evidence class.
coreBuyerValueMetrics.buyerValue: Shows operational ability to maintain a trustworthy local graph.

coreBuyerValueMetrics.name: region_replication_efficiency
coreBuyerValueMetrics.definition: Region-2 launch effort/cost/time compared with frozen Region-1 baseline, explicitly separating reusable core from local acquisition/verification work.
coreBuyerValueMetrics.buyerValue: Tests whether HOY is a repeatable platform rather than a bespoke La Manga project.

claimBoundary: This contract defines how HOY will measure buyer-relevant economic proof. It does not activate Production analytics, does not claim current merchant outcomes, and does not permit clicks or handoffs to be presented as confirmed transactions or revenue.
